CAM_Shot2 (f149-303): bundle-adjusted keys on every unique frame (the f%5==2 duplicates are re-created by hold_residues), 36 mm fixed. The camera is 1.41-1.57 m above the VIP floor, 0.13-0.47 m behind the rail, 0.61 -> 0.95 m from DS's hair bow. The x1.15 push / +12 deg roll / 390 px drift in measured.json are ORB features on DS's hair and the dancing crowd, not the camera (background lamps give x1.03, +3.45 deg image rotation).

Energies are calibrated in Cycles with AgX 'Punchy', exposure 0.

CYCLES vs EEVEE: Cycles ignores Light.volume_factor. StageSpot uses volume_factor 20 and every wash/key uses 0; without the patched build_lights (scratchpad/light/build_scene_patched.py: a volume-only twin with (vf-1)x energy, visible_volume_scatter=False for vf<=0) the beam is ~20x too faint and the washes fog the room in Cycles. EEVEE honours it natively but renders the darks at 0.55-0.7x: for EEVEE use world bg_strength 0.9, BlueWash_Shot3 3600 W and DS_Key ~600 W.

HAZE: one Principled Volume box x -8.2..8.2, y -7.0..14.0, z 0..9.5, density 0.015, #c8d4ff, anisotropy 0.15. The VIP box (y < -7.0) is haze-free, so CAM_Shot2/3 sit outside it; CAM_Shot1 is inside it but looks back into the clear VIP box.
